ItemID: 1; Title: DEWALT Cutting Wheel, General Purpose Metal Cutting, 4-1/2-Inch, 5-Pack (DW8062B5), Multi; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do occasional repairs, but I have no current metal-cutting need or established use for grinder wheels.
ItemID: 2; Title: Gorilla All Weather Outdoor Waterproof Duct Tape, UV and Temperature Resistant, 1.88" x 25 yd, Black, (Pack of 2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I have used Gorilla tape before, and weather resistance would be useful for repairs exposed to moisture.
ItemID: 3; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A strong repair adhesive fits my interest in practical maintenance supplies and complements my vinyl cement.
ItemID: 4; Title: Drill America - POU10-24#10-24 Tap and #25 Drill Bit Kit, POU Series; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This specific thread size would only help with a matching repair, which I do not currently have in mind.
ItemID: 5; Title: DIYMAG Powerful N52 Neodymium Disc Magnets, Permanent, Strong, Rare Earth Magnets. Fridge, DIY, Building, Scientific, Craft, and Office Magnets - 1.26 inch x 1/8 inch, Pack of 10; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a project that calls for strong disc magnets right now.
ItemID: 6; Title: Bolt Dropper 1/2" Stainless Flat Finish Washer, 1-1/4" Outside Diameter - 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel, Highly Corrosion-Resistant and Rustproof - Convenient for Any Project Needs (50 Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need to confirm the washer dimensions against a specific job before buying fifty.
ItemID: 7; Title: Gorilla Super Glue Gel, 20 Gram, Clear, (Pack of 10); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The glue suits small repairs, but ten containers are more than I would choose for occasional use.
ItemID: 8; Title: MILAPEAK 270 PCS Heat Shrink Tubing Kit - 3:1 Ratio Adhesive Lined, Marine Grade Shrink Wrap - Automotive Industrial Heat-Shrink Tubing - Black, Red; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Insulating and sealing wire connections fits my previous purchase of electrical crimp terminals.
ItemID: 9; Title: Wirefy Heat Shrink Tubing Kit - 3:1 Ratio Adhesive Lined, Marine Wire Shrink Wrap Tube - Waterproof Industrial, Automotive & Boat Tubes - Clear - 275 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my wiring interests, but I would choose the black and red kit this time rather than buy two similar assortments.
ItemID: 10; Title: S SATC 25PCS 4 1/2 Cut Off Wheel Grinder Blades 4-1/2" x .045 x 7/8" Cutting Disc Cutting Wheel Die Grinder Cut Off Blades Fits Angle Grinder Air Tool; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Twenty-five cutting discs would be excessive without an ongoing metal-cutting project.
